correctness.rationale: For SG_{4,2}, the stable 4-subsets of cyclic 10 give exactly 25 graph vertices, 60 edges and 19907 simplicial faces including empty. Independently reconstructed the prescribed vertex-pivot matching and checked the entire directed Hasse graph acyclic: one critical three-cell and two critical four-cells survive. Integer matched-face cancellation independently gives a 16-term primitive three-cycle and zero integral Morse differential, so Htilde3=Z and Htilde4=Z², no torsion or other degrees. Its rotation and reflection actions on the primitive H3 generator are +1 and -1. All 20 signed reduced Lefschetz sums independently satisfy L(r^a)=(-1)^a, L(r^as)=3 if a even and 1 if a odd. Since L=-χ3+χ4, χ3 is reflection-sign and χ4=trivial plus rotation-parity. Exhaustive finite construction establishes this one graph only.
residual_risks: Verification is exhaustive for one finite specified complex or group, not a theorem on all graphs or spaces.
